81.alt: Droid D01 by Sharpa, full body, standing
81.identity: Sharpa's homepage labels this asset D01, next to the separate Wave hand products. The record covers Droid D01 and the Wave hand family; the image shows the D01 humanoid, not the Wave hands, and the caption names D01.

84.alt: onero H1 by SwitchBot, full body, waving, on its wheeled base
84.identity: SwitchBot's homepage card for onero H1, image alt "onero H1"; the whole wheeled robot with its base, not the separate arm or fan products. The record is Onero H1.

88.alt: HMND 01 Alpha Wheeled by Humanoid, full body, on its wheeled base
88.identity: Humanoid's homepage image reliability-robot.png shows the wheeled HMND 01. The record covers HMND 01 as two platforms, Alpha Wheeled and Alpha Bipedal, which are not interchangeable; the image is the Alpha Wheeled one and the caption names it. Old specifications in the record have no resolved version and are not attributed to this platform.

94.alt: Wanda 2.0 by UniX AI, full body, front view, on its wheeled base
94.identity: UniX AI's homepage labels this product image Wanda 2.0. The record is Wanda (wheeled dual-arm humanoid, not the separate Martian biped); the image is named Wanda 2.0 and is not taken to show every Wanda generation.

98.alt: Isaac 0 by Weave Robotics, full body, front view, two arms on a column and base
98.identity: Weave's homepage file isaac-0-front.webp, alt "Isaac 0". The record is Isaac without a generation; the master notes that Isaac 1 uses a wheeled base and Isaac 0 is stationary. The image is Isaac 0, not Isaac 1, and the casters on its base are not taken as powered locomotion.

72.alt: Aria, a full-body Series 1, standing on its lit base
72.identity: Realbotix's homepage image aria-full-body.jpg, whose own alt reads "Aria, a full-body Series1, standing on its lit base". The whole robot with both hands, feet and its circular lit base. The record is Aria; the caption names Series 1.

133.alt: MABEL, the open-source mobile bimanual robot, full body, on its column and base
133.identity: Image from the official MABEL project website (caption: MABEL standing in front of a grey curtain); the whole robot with both antennas, both manipulators, column, cables and base. The record is MABEL v1.0, an open-source mobile bimanual robot.

189.alt: Linker Humanoid by Linkerbot, full body, on its wheeled base
189.identity: Linkerbot's Linker Humanoid page, image detail-2.png: the whole wheeled platform with its lifting column, not the cropped torso shown in a living room on the same page. The record is Linker Humanoid.

192.alt: Asimov 1 by Menlo, full body, front view, standing
192.identity: Menlo's Asimov 1 page, image asimov-orange-full-front-cutout.webp, alt "Asimov 1 humanoid robot, front view": the finished orange model with both feet, not the kit or build stages. The record is Asimov 1.

203.alt: ugo Nova by ugo, full body, front view, on its wheeled base
203.identity: ugo's ugo Nova product page, image img_nova_spec.png in the specification section: the complete wheeled platform with its grippers and base. The record is ugo Nova.
